notes.title: Tilt Brush v23.2 update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
[list][*] Fixed Poly uploads from 23.0 and 23.1 not rendering correctly in Poly. Existing data will be fixed; but if you run into this bug in the future, make sure you are using Tilt Brush 23.2 or later and re-upload your sketch.
[*] Fixed missing field-of-view when rendering camera paths.
[*] Fixed inability to load sketches if they used deleted or missing Poly assets.
[/list]

notes.notes:

[*] Fix camera path interpolation if path is looped and contains an odd number of rotations
[/list]

notes.title: Tilt Brush v18.4 update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix textures on Poly objects not re-uploading back to Poly correctly.  That is, when a textured object was loaded from the Poly Panel, and then that sketch was uploaded to Poly, the texture wouldn't show. We fixed that.
[/list]
Thanks to Miguelangelo for the heads up!

Thanks for your patience while we tracked this down, and happy holidays from the Tilt Brush team 🎅🏼🤶🏼!

notes.title: Tilt Brush 7.5 update
notes.notes:
Hello!  A larger point release today.  Lots of polish polish polish.

Including:
[list]
[*] Support for importing multiple models and images from the Media Library.
[*] Ability to pin models and images to prevent accidental movement.
[*] Toggleable constrained rotation on models and images.
[*] Toggleable snapping on straightedge and mirror.
[*] "Animal ruler" shows relative size when using the scale feature.
[*] Video capture now records with audio.
[/list]

Full goodness here: 
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview] Release notes [/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush 7.2 update
notes.notes:
Improvements & bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed: In 7.0, the last centimeter of a stroke was sometimes not saved
[*] Fixed: The flat brush shader was causing the start and end of Flat strokes to be invisible
[*] Fixed: Video capture could break if Tilt Brush was not launched via Steam
[*] Fixed: Bad .png files could cause crashes
[*] Fixed: Occasional permanent slowdown when flipping pages quickly in the Asset Library
[/list]

notes.title: Tilt Brush 1.2 update
notes.notes:
Tilt Brush has been updated to version 1.2!

This update consists primarily of under-the-hood engine upgrades. It also includes many polish and performance improvements, one completely new kind of brush, and an upgrade to the Snapshot tool.

Snapshot is now the [b]Multi Cam[/b]. Swipe to choose between HD snapshots and animated gifs. As always, the pictures you take are saved to [b]My Documents\Tilt Brush\Snapshots[/b].

Enjoy!
